defects.title: Cables do not attach to apparatus
defects.finding: Independent literal paths ended at empty space or missed foil/terminals.
defects.repair: Named device ports feed cable endpoints in both compositions; decorative cable and unused jar removed.
defects.acceptance: Review every terminal and full route throughout motion and across all recurring shots.

defects.title: Hand, sleeve and lever move independently
defects.finding: Hand translated while lever and cuff stayed fixed.
defects.repair: One mechanism state drives rotating lever, grip, wrist and two-link arm. Dedicated grip candidate remains unapproved.
defects.acceptance: Review closed grip, thumb opposition, wrist contact, cuff overlap and contact timing in motion.

defects.title: Camera movement substitutes for meaningful action
defects.finding: Static paths plus small whole-object translations do not establish believable action.
defects.repair: Rebuild blocking and articulated motion one shot at a time.
defects.acceptance: Watch with camera locked and audio muted; required action must remain clear. Deliberate stillness needs a story reason.

defects.title: View and scene are hard to understand
defects.finding: User reports poor views and unclear scenes; no viewer comprehension test exists.
defects.repair: Redesign camera, silhouettes, scale and action staging before texture.
defects.acceptance: An unfamiliar viewer identifies actor, action, target and change from first/middle/last frames and silent playback.

defects.title: Body proportions are poor
defects.finding: Shared schematic head is enlarged for hero portraits; body has no anatomical rig.
defects.repair: Create character model sheets and dedicated hero drawings, compare references.
defects.acceptance: Review head/body ratios, limb lengths, foreshortening and identity across every appearance.

defects.title: Hands look wrong
defects.finding: Finger count alone does not prove anatomy, grasp or gesture.
defects.repair: Compare referenced hand poses; macro grip candidate only addresses attachment.
defects.acceptance: Review finger count, lengths, knuckles, thumb opposition, gesture and contact at native resolution and in motion.

defects.title: Characters appear incomplete
defects.finding: Unclear crops, floating parts or accidental omissions must not be justified as style.
defects.repair: Draw complete underlying anatomy and define intentional occlusion/cropping.
defects.acceptance: Review full construction without shadows/cloth and then final framing; every visible part has a plausible parent.

defects.title: Physics and effects lack causes
defects.finding: Sparks and crackle fired at scheduled times while a stationary lever never made contact; weight/support unverified.
defects.repair: Remove unsupported discharge; geometric constraints implemented. Circuit validity, body weight and collision remain unverified.
defects.acceptance: Validate support, collision and event causes. Source any historical apparatus behavior; geometry tests do not certify electricity.

defects.title: Overall style rejected
defects.finding: User rejects style. Previous house-style proposal was treated too much like an approved direction.
defects.repair: Compare materially different style frames using the same narrative beat; confirm direction before scaling.
defects.acceptance: User accepts a concrete style frame and motion sample; unified art, anatomy, material and lighting pass review.

defects.title: Configuration passes without film quality
defects.finding: Renderer validation checked timing and hashes but not rejection state, shot reviews or open defects. Conflicting shot-lock documents.
defects.repair: Add memory and shot quality gate to strict-final; align all-active-item lock rules.
defects.acceptance: A rejected style, open defect, missing review or stale evidence must fail strict-final even if Item statuses are final.

shots.action: Locate the story in a hostile historical city and visually target Victor's laboratory.
Fading candle, proportionate draped body and Victor at doorway; tableau inspired by the 1831 frontispiece.
Hold on Victor's fear with the face partly obscured rather than a generic front-facing portrait.
Diagnostic shared-anchor mechanism and coupled grip study; art, physics and historical circuit remain unapproved.
Dull yellow eye opens in candle shadow; restrained portrait crop.
Return to the tableau as the creature rises and Victor recoils, then resolve into title.
